objective: Test whether sparse player histories benefit from longer recency support without sacrificing faster adaptation for established players.

mechanism.level: direct-I2 batter-pitcher event probability vector before park adjustment and inning state propagation
mechanism.support_definition: minimum of batter and pitcher raw I2 PA counts strictly before the active monthly model cutoff
mechanism.high_support: w365 approaches 1, so established matchups approach the preferred 365 model

selection.primary: pooled exact full-I2 Under 0.5 log loss
selection.default_if_not_cleared: retain universal 365; do not add support-adaptive complexity

next_step: Implement exact evaluator using already-fitted 365 and 730 monthly models; no new model refits required.
